changes.observable_property: After NGUI has settled the localized ResizeHeight Effect label, PrayerClarity keeps the entire visible prayer action-button geometry below the Effect block with 8 UI units of clearance and grows the verified real pulpit root window only when that settled button placement would violate the 10-unit bottom margin.
changes.canonical_owner: PrayerClarity owns the Effect UILabel and final craft-button placement. The visible action button is the union of active UIWidget children under UI Root/Pray GUI/window/craft button, while the real UI Root/Pray GUI/window UIWidget owns the parchment height. Exact Graveyard Keeper 1.407 source proves PrayCraftGUI derives MonoBehaviour, so a one-shot next-frame coroutine on the existing GUI instance can observe NGUI after its layout pass without a persistent Update hook.
changes.final_writer_or_commit_point: PrayCraftGUI.RedrawTextValues postfix remains the presentation entry point. PulpitPolish first renders/resets the button, then schedules a bounded next-frame settled-layout pass on that same PrayCraftGUI MonoBehaviour. That pass is the final PrayerClarity writer of button Y and, only when required, requests root-window growth through PulpitLayoutV4.
blast_radius: PrayerClarity pulpit action-button vertical placement after a prayer selection/redraw
PrayerClarity pulpit root height only when settled localized content plus the full visible button would otherwise violate the preserved clearance/margin
No other tooltip, Technology, inventory, mechanics, save-state, or prayer-result surface
preserved_invariants: Prayer wording, localization strings, mechanics, success values and rewards remain unchanged
Existing +100 UI-unit pulpit height and +10 width remain the minimum baseline
Short prayers/locales do not receive extra window height when the settled geometry already fits
Effect-to-visible-button clearance is 8 UI units and button-to-window-bottom margin is at least 10 UI units
The whole active visible button geometry is measured, not only its UILabel
Layout work is event-driven and bounded after redraw; no permanent per-frame production polling is added
Pulpit restore returns captured stock geometry
